notes.title: Work on "Hail to the Rainbow" game is nearing completion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/4f50fbb48fad5525e5fb4195c08d0527a92628c0.jpg[/img]


Hello! I've been working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699230/Hail_to_the_Rainbow/]"Hail to the Rainbow"[/url] for five years now. Crazy timing, especially for an indie. The process is intense and emotionally difficult. With each new game you try to invest more and more, pay attention to details, you want to make everything as perfect as possible, and this makes development time longer

I finally completed the base of the game, finished all the locations, mechanics and started polishing the project. In general, there is still a lot of work, but the finale is already visible ahead. Last week I played the entire project for the first time, from start to finish. [b]Walkthrough took about 10 hours![/b]

Also, the voice acting for the game was recently completed. For the first time in my project there will be English voice acting. In my practice, this is a big and difficult step, I hope, despite the nuances, it will be a pleasant addition for players :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/b4026e8fd69ae839665c7df9c593947373798aa8.gif[/img]



It’s not often possible to share the results and remind that work is moving forward, but sometimes I share various materials in public pages. I will give a few examples here.

[previewyoutube=077ywiIdiz8;full][/previewyoutube] 

Recent video with a fragment of a cut scene

[previewyoutube=aNK40msGBsU;full][/previewyoutube]


Many thanks to everyone who follows the development, adds to the wishlist and waits for the release, it is very supportive and inspiring! Good luck to all!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Another year has passed, difficult for many, filled with emotional upheavals and uncertainty. Sometimes I wonder why people continue to play scary and depressing games when there are so many similar things around us in real life. But for some reason we love to immerse ourselves in virtual worlds like these. Perhaps it’s easier for us, because there the danger is just a scenario, we can easily stop events, put them on pause. In life, unfortunately, we cannot do this.

I wish you all good luck next year, so that real danger avoids you as much as possible, strength, good health and a peaceful sky above your head!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/d25ae5a6c417179aae80a4926be97cdd7948db76.gif[/img]

My work continues. I had plans to update already released projects, but the current work on the Hail to the Rainbow game takes a lot of time. At the moment I am nearing the completion of the project. I really hope to complete the work by the end of 24. In the meantime, you can take a closer look at “Hail to the Rainbow” on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699230/Hail_to_the_Rainbow/]Steam page[/url], and also watch a short New Year’s video based on the game.

[previewyoutube=QZchfXg-grM;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Teaser of "Hail to the Rainbow" game.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LXV_-PPBm-w;full][/previewyoutube]


Greetings ! A lot of time has passed since the publication of the latest news, but the work has not stood still and I am finally happy to announce that my new project called "Hail to the Rainbow" has a   [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699230/Hail_to_the_Rainbow/]page on Steam[/url] .

This is my fifth author's project, which is currently under development. The game takes place in an alternate universe. Advanced technology to improve the life of mankind, led to the collapse of mankind. Ideas about the world of the game appeared in my mind since the time of work on "7th Sector". This universe seemed to me extremely interesting and suitable for deep immersion and explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/532d5e0e1c82a31d6039219064c9f191c916a47f.gif[/img]

"Hail to the Rainbow" is a massive project with great attention to detail. The work has been going on for about 2 years and the final revision will take about the same amount (approximate forecast).


In the meantime, I will be glad for the interest shown and the addition of the game to the wishlist. There is a long way ahead, during which I will try to share materials and best practices. Some content will be published on the [url=https://www.patreon.com/SergeyNoskov]Patreon[/url]  channel.

Good luck to all!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/a33247589f6175a22716f4ae24cc42bb1192d1b8.jpg[/img]

Hello friends! Happy New Year to everyone! The past year has been difficult and the latest events in the world are like some kind of fantastic TV show or game with an unpredictable plot. In this regard, I would like to wish everyone to survive in the new 2022 without losses :)  All health, patience and strength! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/5f91a1af9d7c1046ba5aa12f857a033a7f9e2eef.gif[/img]


About projects, at the beginning of the year there will be a small update of the game "35MM" with full support for the gamepad. There will also be some bug fixes. 

An updated version of the game "35MM" with a photo mode will be released on consoles this spring. The event is very important for me, because for a long time the fate of the project on consoles was not clear. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/bfbc38aea241db4c195ce523593f1d22c6300f3d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/5d51226576eba6cd995e9572b6f36653e03946ec.jpg[/img][/url]

The latest news is the release of the console version of the game in physical media from [url=https://www.redartgames.com/presentation?rp=in-rays-of-the-light]Red Art Games[/url].  Soon the box will reach me :) 

Also now I am actively working on a new project "Hail to the Rainbow". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/55c596c976bf1f9bb88d906b8dcd49cdeea01ea9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/71f0ba2dff2a29c5c8aeadfac5dd3a04d2990cc3.jpg[/img]

But closer to spring, the game will finally get a Steam page, a teaser and other visual content. 

Good luck!

notes.title: New Project
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/3a4551b9e78f74427c9e4d20e819358739407770.jpg[/img]

Greetings friends! I announce the beginning of the development of a new project. Working title: "Rainbow" or "Glory to the Rainbow". I have very serious plans, the scale of the project is large, the idea is global and very detailed. Previously, I did not pay so much attention to the plot and history, I already foresee sleepless nights X)

The game is a kind of symbiosis of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/466500/35MM/?curator_clanid=33976621]35MM[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/749250/7th_Sector/?curator_clanid=33976621]7th Sector[/url]. I decided to use my most successful tricks - an atmosphere of despondency, devastation and post-USSR, seasoned with a dramatic story. The story of a boy named Ignat and his life after the war in alternative Russia. A deep study of the character, world and events is planned. The fantastic theme provides a lot of room for ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/dec157d1b31fcf9d2609fbb33417d89f81574338.gif[/img]

As a basis for the main character, I decided to take the image of a boy from the video [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KJgYqlZeSy4]ZAMILSKA "CALL" / Elektro_sonda[/url]  
 As soon as I saw him (the boy), I realized that this is exactly the image that I want to see in the game.
A great inspiration for the future atmosphere of the project was given to me by the amazing works of Simon Stalenhag, on which I had my eyes for a long time (I am not attaching work, you can google it)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/6dd1a0af15cd2afe3e59d2698b12752235925fd8.jpg[/img]

Overall, I plan on improving the quality level a lot. I really hope that all the ideas will be implemented, although it will take a long time.

 I will keep abreast of developments and find a minute to publish!

Also, I will be very grateful for support, informational and in general of any kind!

PS.  In connection with Halloween, there will soon be an interesting competition with a cash prize associated with the project The Light Remake. There will be a post next week!

notes.content:
Hello! I added some fixes.

- start in windowed mode (in the SaveData file, set _WindowMode to 1)

- Intro sound now uses player save

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
A  new changes

-Added brightness setting
-Fixed a bug with an electric shield in the lecture room
-Added glow  effect  outside the windows when we are in the building
- Moved to the "Settings" menu explanations about turning off the Headbob, soft mouse, inversion and center point

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
Hello! Update 1.02  

- Small changes on the location
- A flashlight look to the map when viewing it
- After opening both doors in the corridor, the green key off(so as not to confuse the player)
- Fixed flying character effect
- Added setting to disable waving camera  when walking. BobHead parameter (H key)
- Fixed telekinesis-bug when a character could interact with objects from afar
- A little optimization, it’s not for sure
- Fixed a slot machine bug when an item popped out of a “hand” or wasn’t caught
- When explore objects, a ray of a flashlight  is directed at them
- Small edit  of mouse. The movement became smoother, without jerking

A small livehack has also been added, if there is a problem with the screen resolution (for example, black bars on the sides), you can press R (quickly, several times) to reset the resolution to 1280 x 720. Maybe someone will help.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hello! Update 1.01

-Added disabling post-effects (using a text file). It can help to fix visual bugs (black screen, color distortion) and to optimize. As a last resort.
-Memory load is slightly less
-Added inversion of the Y axis of the mouse (Y key)
-Added a point in the center of the screen (C)
-Added a change in the smoothness of control, the movement of the camera and character become sharper (M)
-Changed the highlight of interactive objects
-Intro warns about saving at checkpoints
-Added control of lock puzzles and using WSAD

If you have problems with the picture, the screen turned black (disabling SSR does not help), or the colors are distorted, you can try to start the game without post effects. To do this, rename the SaveData0 file to SaveData in the root folder (it is better to save the original SaveData in reserve).

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Update 1.0 !

 
- Fixed some passes through textures
- Added automatic set  English language  at first start (for English speakers)
- Mouse camera rotation parameters
- Changed the location of some objects, for more intuitive clarity (photos and coins are now in a different place, more logical)
- Fixed a bug with a black screen ( problem with SSR post-effect)
- The chromatic aberration is   smoothed so that it is not striking
- Edits in the texts
- Fixed bug with undamped heartbeat
- Added descripts to effects in settings
 - Interactive objects are brighter highlighted

As many people know, fixing bugs sometimes gives rise to new bugs, but I hope that this is not the case and everything will work well) Please inform me if the camera control seems normal after the update. I have already “eyes blurred” . I can’t accurately evaluate. Thanks to all!

For the future, an update with a free camera (in the Noclip style) and something like a photo mode with a couple of settings are planned.

notes.title: After Release
notes.content:
Hi guys! On the third day after the release of The Light Remake, I want to say thank you very much to everyone who supported me and my work, who were waiting for the release of the game, who bought the game, expressed an opinion, wrote a review. Or he didn’t write, but simply digested the impressions within himself. Many thanks to everyone who is waiting for new projects . The support and interest of the audience is very inspiring and is one of the main motivation factors for me. It's very cool when you see how the work gives the public some topics for reflection and new experiences. So, it’s not in vain))

Tomorrow there will be a small update with some improvements and bug fixes !

notes.title: Work in progress
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/2f946f661a42de7b2d60361c116eb9dada13937d.jpg[/img]

Hello! Work on the game in progress. The work is not going as fast as I would like, but now there are so many other things that finding time is not easy. In parallel, I deal with some other tasks, so I have to jump from one to another. Perhaps this is even good, because the monotonous and routine work is constantly replaced by something new.

There is not much content in the game, but I really try to pay attention to every detail. Recently, many interesting technical elements have been created, about which I even plan to write a short article later, maybe for someone it will be useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/dd607a2018fd7335ec2f0568babec3166f353e76.png[/img]

I am adding new content, updating textures, old models and waiting for news from my composer :) For this project, the music will be written by the author of the soundtrack for the game "35MM" - Dmitry Nikolayev. Collaboration continues!

notes.title: Work in progress
notes.content:
Hello! Work on a remaster of the game "Light"  in progress.
A lot of content is improved, new objects are added, including interactive objects. Entered Interesting technical solutions, that  I have not previously used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/e6f74bb8223e9e3877fd4df94468f393a8e6a57e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/c6af62bf90862e46d89e92a34cdbac0379ab5f0d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/0fc1f3855d3ea7cb609a6552fbb30c2ccf16f096.jpg[/img]

This week I completed work on a water shader that accepts reflections, has soft edges when intersecting with geometry, reacts to the player walk, and most importantly, it receives light.

I also made a transparent  shader for decals, graffiti, etc., receive shadows.

  + made a simple caustic effect (light refraction) using a projector. The script searches for  a water surface nearby and smoothly enable  the effect.
